meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文章、笔记或主题变成一段有画面有解说的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把现成文字内容做成不露脸的讲解视频发出去
copy.tagline_en: Turn an article, notes or topic into a narrated explainer video with custom visuals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you turn written ideas into faceless explainer videos to publish online

howto.what: 把一段文字(文章、笔记、话题、简报)做成无真人出镜的解说视频:每帧视觉由它现场设计,如排版、抽象图形、图表,再用 HyperFrames 逐帧搭建,最后渲染出 mp4。
howto.when: 当你做话题解说、概念拆解、操作教程等文字类视频时触发;若要从网站做宣传视频应改用 /product-launch-video,意图不明时先走 /hyperframes。

say.note: 项目名按话题取,如复利解说

say.text: 这是份操作教程,帮我做成无出镜解说视频

howto.what_en: Turns text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video. Each scene's visuals are invented (typography, abstract graphics, data-viz) and built frame by frame in HyperFrames, then rendered to video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos and listicles from text. For a video built from a website use /product-launch-video; if unclear, go through /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this article on compound interest into an explainer video
say_en.note: Project is named after the topic

say_en.text: Here's a how-to guide — make it an explainer video
say_en.note: You approve the frame-by-frame plan first

say_en.text: Use a male voice for the narration
